mechanism_narrative: Four consecutive weeks of WORKPLACES mobility recovery (-22.1 to -12.0) indicate restored commuting and lunch/after-work shopping routines, which should continue to lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as office-adjacent retail footfall normalizes.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES continuing its upward trend, or WORKPLACES stalls while RETAIL_REC still rises, breaking the co-movement.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week drop in PARKS (-13.4 to -21.7) signals renewed public caution or an unannounced tightening of outdoor gathering rules; this caution is expected to spill over into reduced discretionary retail visits within one week, pulling RETAIL_REC down.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped 8.3 points in the latest week after three weeks of stability
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise in the week following the PARKS drop, or PARKS rebounds without any corresponding dip in RETAIL_REC.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both trend upward simultaneously, the combined effect of restored commuting infrastructure use and office attendance compounds to produce a disproportionately larger lift in RETAIL_REC than either series would predict alone, because commuters combine trips with retail errands.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth rate over the next two weeks is no larger than what a linear model using TRANSIT or WORKPLACES alone would predict, indicating no interaction effect.

mechanism_narrative: Singapore's phased reopening policy (Phase 3 Heightened Alert easing) has been incrementally relaxing capacity and dining restrictions, evidenced by the steady narrowing of RETAIL_REC and WORKPLACES deficits; continuation of this policy regime should keep driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Government reinstates tightened measures and RETAIL_REC reverses its upward trajectory despite no change in the observed policy-easing proxies.

mechanism_narrative: The steady decline in RESIDENTIAL time (20.0 to 16.0 over four weeks) indicates households are spending progressively less time at home, a behavioral shift toward out-of-home activity that should translate into higher RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks as discretionary outings resume.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL continues to fall but RETAIL_REC fails to rise or declines, indicating the inverse relationship has broken down.

mechanism_narrative: The onset of Singapore's southwest monsoon season increases rainfall frequency, suppressing outdoor PARKS activity (seen in the latest week's drop) and displacing some recreational demand toward indoor shopping malls, producing a short-term uptick in RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls while RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises or stays flat
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell sharply to -21.7 in the most recent week while RETAIL_REC improved slightly
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in the same week that PARKS falls, indicating no substitution from outdoor to indoor activity.

mechanism_narrative: The weekly increment in RETAIL_REC has been shrinking each week (+8.0, +2.8, +0.7), indicating the recovery is decelerating and approaching a plateau; once the weekly gain falls below 1 point for two consecutive weeks, the series is likely to stagnate or reverse over the next four weeks rather than keep climbing.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly increment falls below 1 point for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:weekly increments of RETAIL_REC have shrunk from 8.0 to 2.8 to 0.7 over the last three transitions
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's weekly gains accelerate again or remain above 1 point consistently, and the four-week mean continues to rise rather than plateau.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has plateaued (6.7 to 5.1) even as TRANSIT continues to recover strongly, suggesting that recovery is concentrated in transit-dependent commerce rather than broad-based essential retail; this selective pattern implies RETAIL_REC gains will be modest and uneven, limiting overall four-week upside unless both series co-move upward.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises strongly even though GROCERY_PHARM stays flat or declines and TRANSIT growth stalls, indicating the hypothesized interaction is not predictive.
